title: 第十章 下段踢

content_zh:
对于林铮那逆天的狗屎运，众人已经无法发表什么了，瞠目乍舌了一阵，便开始着手boss的击杀行动。
“好了，现在分配一下位子！”杨琪考虑了一下说道，“招架人员就由我和小林子来，小林子，没问题吧？”
“应该没问题！”对于自己的身手，林铮还是很有信心的。
“那就好！”杨琪点了下头，又朝蒂法和龙牙道：“这边我和小林子的攻击最高，所以我们交换招架的时候，会吸引boss大部分的仇恨，你们两个攻击的时候要注意下，避免过多输出拉了boss的仇恨！！”
“霸王，春风，boss咆哮的时候你们上去，拉走boss，趁这个机会小喵把我和神棍的血加满，之后我和神棍会再次与boss展开招架！Boss狂暴的时候小喵你就要辛苦点了，必须保证我和神棍的血量在八成以上！不然我们俩就死定了！”
“那个！那个！加血的话来得及，就是我的蓝不够啊！”小喵着急地说道。
“嘿嘿！不要紧，刚刚杀了傲剑的家伙我可是捡了不少的蓝！”林铮得意地将蓝交易给小喵，这样一来，小喵的法力问题也解决了！一切准备就绪，可以开始了！
“那么现在，小林子！上！”杨琪娇喝一声，双手握紧黑鸦剑便冲向了boss，林铮紧随其后，一下还超过了杨琪，在他之前与boss碰面了！林铮冲了上前便是一记践踏，-435，这boss的防御，实在叫人无语，居然只有这点伤害，无语归无语林铮还是挥起匕首狠狠地扎了boss两下，-185，-168！眼看boss挥着斧头砍下，林铮举起匕首便是一档，叮——！两件武器招架到了一起，-240的伤害从林铮头上飘起来，这时一道白光落下+240，而林铮和boss也在这个时候向后一倾，失去平衡！同一时间，杨琪冲了上前交换林铮的位子，大喝一声，一记重剑骑士的招牌技能“怒斩”便朝boss劈下，-570，好家伙，伤害比林铮高多了！同一时间，蒂法和龙牙的箭矢和火球也到来，-174,-340！杨琪抓紧时间，又给了boss两剑，每剑都有200左右的伤害，最后也是一挡，黑鸦剑与boss的斧头招架到了一起！
“小林子！”
“来了！别叫！”调整好的林铮再次顶上，不想boss这次倒是很干脆地咆哮起来了！见状，霸王和春风赶紧冲了上去，霸王使用“叫阵”，很是顺利地将咆哮完的boss从林铮二人身边拉开，春风则不时招架boss，免得boss杀了霸王，要知道现在治疗可都落在林铮两人身上。
“小心了，按刚才看到的情况，boss咆哮完很快就会狂暴！”林铮冲霸王二人喊道，果不其然！Boss在被春风砍了几剑之后咆哮着进入狂暴状态。霸王马上就挨了一斧头，一千多的伤害可不是开玩笑的！再来一下霸王就要就要交代在这了，关键时候，春风挡住了boss的斧头，而满血的林铮二人也赶紧冲过去接替二人的位子。
这狂暴状态可真不是开玩笑的，就是挡住了，林铮一下也要掉800以上的气血，就他的气血也就两下的事儿，杨琪主要加的是力量，气血也不是很多，两下也吃不消，还好小喵真的很给力，血量拉得很快，保证了每次招架前二人都有九成的血量，这才没让两人死在boss的斧头下，当然，为此她把林铮给的蓝用了个精光！
不过，这一切都是值得的！等得boss的狂暴状态一过，林铮二人再次轻松起来，十分默契地交换招架，死死地压制着boss的攻击，boss的血量在几人消磨下，快速下降，几分钟后，boss终于就剩下一点血皮了，林铮很不客气地一记炸裂践踏在boss的肚子上，“彭！”炸裂的波动从boss的肚子上扩散，如同一面火墙立在了林铮面前，而boss也给林铮一脚踏飞，头上冒出来惊人的伤害-3240！暴击了！Boss猛地撞到了一棵树上又震落到地面，华丽丽地大爆了一地的东西！
“靠！大丰收了！”杨琪兴奋地大叫一声，冲向了boss的尸体，其他人也欢呼着跑了过去，这boss打得可不容易啊，一个个精神紧绷，累死了！这boss一死，一个个就亢奋起来了！
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢网游之剑刃舞者请大家
content_en:
Everyone could say nothing about Lin Zheng's unlucky luck. They were stunned for a while and then started to kill the boss.
"Okay, now let's allocate the seats!" Yang Qi thought for a moment and said, "Xiao Linzi and I will be the ones to handle the fight. Xiao Linzi, is that okay?"
"It should be no problem!" Lin Zheng was still very confident in his own skills.
"That's good!" Yang Qi nodded, and then said to Tifa and Longya: "Xiao Linzi and I have the highest attack here, so when we exchange parries, we will attract most of the boss's hatred. You two should be careful when attacking to avoid excessive output and draw the boss's hatred!!"
"Overlord, Spring Breeze, when the boss roars, you go up and pull the boss away. Take this opportunity to fill up the health of me and Shengun. After that, Shengun and I will fight with the boss again! When the boss is violent, you will have to work harder. You must make sure that the health of me and Shengun is above 80%! Otherwise, we are both dead!"
"That! That! I can add blood in time, but I don't have enough mana!" Xiao Miao said anxiously.
"Hehe! It doesn't matter, I just killed the guy with Ao Jian and I picked up a lot of blue!" Lin Zheng proudly traded blue to Xiao Miao. In this way, Xiao Miao's mana problem was also solved! Everything is ready to start!
"Now, Xiao Linzi! Come on!" Yang Qi shouted, holding the Black Crow Sword with both hands and rushing towards the boss. Lin Zheng followed closely behind, surpassing Yang Qi and met the boss before him! Lin Zheng rushed forward and trampled him, -435. This boss's defense was really speechless. It only did this little damage. After being speechless, Lin Zheng still swung his dagger and stabbed the boss twice, -185, -168! Seeing the boss swinging his ax to chop down, Lin Zheng raised his dagger and hit the first gear, ding——! The two weapons parried together, and -240 damage floated from Lin Zheng's head. At this time, a white light fell +240, and Lin Zheng and the boss also leaned back at this time, losing their balance! At the same time, Yang Qi rushed forward to exchange Lin Zheng's seat, shouted, and struck the boss with the signature skill of the epee knight "furious slash", -570, good guy, the damage is much higher than Lin Zheng! At the same time, arrows and fireballs from Tifa and Dragon Fang also arrived, -174, -340! Yang Qi seized the time and gave the boss two more swords. Each sword dealt about 200 damage. In the end, it was also a block. The Black Crow Sword and the boss's ax were parried together!
"Xiao Linzi!"
"Here we come! Don't scream!" Lin Zheng, who had adjusted himself, stepped forward again. Unexpectedly, the boss roared very simply this time! Seeing this, Bawang and Chunfeng rushed forward. Bawang used the "Calling Formation" to successfully pull the roaring boss away from Lin Zheng and the two of them. Chunfeng parried the boss from time to time to prevent the boss from killing Bawang. You must know that the treatment now falls on Lin Zheng and the two.
"Be careful, according to what I just saw, the boss will become violent soon after roaring!" Lin Zheng shouted to the two Overlords, and it was true! The boss roared into a violent state after being slashed several times by Spring Breeze. The Overlord immediately received an axe, and more than a thousand injuries were no joke! The Overlord is about to be revealed here again. At the critical moment, Spring Breeze blocked the boss's axe, and Lin Zheng and Lin Zheng, who were full of health, rushed over to take their places.
This violent state is really no joke. Even if he blocks it, Lin Zheng will lose more than 800 qi and blood in one hit. His qi and blood only lasts for two hits. Yang Qi mainly adds strength, and the qi and blood are not very much. Two hits are not enough. Fortunately, Xiaomiao is really powerful and can increase the blood volume very quickly., ensuring that the two people had 90% of their health before each parry, so that they did not die under the boss's axe. Of course, for this reason, she used up all the blue that Lin Zheng gave her!
However, it's all worth it! After the boss's violent state was over, Lin Zheng and Lin Zheng became relaxed again. They exchanged parries in a tacit understanding and suppressed the boss's attacks. The boss's blood volume dropped rapidly as a few people wore it down. After a few minutes, the boss finally had a little blood skin left. Lin Zheng rudely trampled on the boss's belly with a burst, "Peng!" The explosion wave spread from the boss's belly, like a wall of fire standing in front of Lin Zheng, and the boss was also kicked by Lin Zheng, and an astonishing amount of damage - 3240 appeared on his head! A critical hit! The Boss slammed into a tree and fell to the ground, exploding everything on the ground beautifully!
"Damn! It's a great harvest!" Yang Qi shouted excitedly and rushed towards the boss's body. Others also ran over cheering. It was not easy to fight this boss. They were all tense and exhausted! As soon as this boss died, everyone became excited!
